notes: Nill Download Manager 2.0.3 — the Windows downloads are now the size they should be. The installer drops from 101.5 MB to about 5 MB and the portable ZIP from 134 MB to about 6 MB, because the video components (yt-dlp, deno, ffmpeg) are no longer bundled: like Linux, the app fetches them once in the background on first launch, each verified against a pinned SHA-256, with no setup screens or prompts — a video started while they are still arriving begins on its own when they land. Existing Windows installs keep the components they already have, so nothing is re-downloaded. Also fixed: Ctrl/Shift multi-row selection in the download list could silently fall back to a single selection on WebKit setups that drop modifier state from click events. The interface, the download engine and Linux behaviour are otherwise unchanged.
